description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to acquire the Land of Borella, Thibirigasyaya D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for urban development projects. It contains a presidential order declaring that specific lands are required for construction of Public Servants Apartments Complex and development activities related to a Science and Technology City. The document includes detailed schedules (I and II) with specific land descriptions, boundaries, and measurements. This fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it focuses on land acquisition and property matters for development purposes, rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
